description.value: Food Folk Eatery is a food court venue inside McArthurGlen Designer Outlet Vancouver, a large open-air outlet mall directly across from the SkyTrain Canada Line's Templeton Station in Richmond. The centre sits only two stops from Vancouver International Airport and about 20 minutes from downtown Vancouver, placing it on a heavily trafficked cycling corridor near the Sea Island routes. Outdoor seating is available at the eatery, and the surrounding centre offers a variety of quick-service food vendors including Cha House, JAPADOG, and A&W.
